mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment and low housing starts indicate a weak labor market and depressed consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% and HOUST < 1600.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts signal strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods with rising HOUST, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market and rising consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a supply contraction that reduces corporate profits and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation and high unemployment (stagflation) signal economic distress that increases equity risk premiums and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200 and UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production signals reduced output capacity and higher input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of supply shock periods with declining INDPRO, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
